messages:
Lena: quick idea  ship a 2-week "mini-refapp" blitz: three tiny tutorials + an OSS launch post. goal: fast onboarding + measurable inbound.
Omar: yes. propose levels: 5-min quickstart, 15-min integration, 30-min optimize. each with a tiny benchmark snippet.
Vik: I can provide perf numbers: tokens/sec, p50 latency, and a back-of-envelope $/1k tokens for default vs q4 quant. will keep numbers rounded.
Tess: design can do 2 hero images + 1 GIF. marketing copy: short dev-first headings and a 3-tweet thread.
Lena: include a migration note for people on other runtimes and a contributor checklist in the OSS post. add a short eval harness and expected outputs file.
Omar: infra  reserving a dev GPU pool Tue-Thu next week. will upload sample dataset (anonymized) and benchmark CSV to the repo.
Tess: suggested A/B test on landing: "Get started in 5 minutes" vs "See real cost savings". we track signups + time-to-first-run.
Lena: good. ops-bot  create checklist and schedule a 30m kickoff for Mon 11am. also add tasks for AB test and closed beta invites (10 devs).
ops-bot: created task card at https://git.redwood/internal/refapps/mini-blitz/board and scheduled "mini-refapp blitz kickoff" Mon 11:00  invites sent to Lena, Omar, Vik, Tess.
